rea.reason: The registered adapter rejected Ghidra 12.2; its configured Java 21 also did not satisfy that Ghidra release.

fallback.authority: Direct Ghidra/LLVM static analysis and controlled Unicorn 2.1.4 instruction replay; these are not REA Evidence records.

limitations: Decompiled pseudocode is not original source and requires manual interpretation.
ARM functions have not been automatically matched to AVR functions; temperature tables and ROM defaults are independently corroborated in AVR flash.
ARM double is 64-bit and AVR double is 32-bit; the ARM replay does not prove exact AVR numerical parity.
Watchdog replay mocks only the clock and shutdown-call boundaries.
No physical hardware tests or full firmware qualification.
